agents.name: Observability Agent
agents.description: Correlates alerts, enriches incidents with CMDB dependency maps, validates post-change state.

agents.name: Remediation Agent
agents.description: Executes approved runbooks — disk cleanup, pod restarts, app pool recycles, session host failover.

agents.name: Capacity Agent
agents.description: Forecasts storage and pool runway, models remediation outcomes before they are approved.

agents.name: Patch & Compliance Agent
agents.description: Stages cumulative updates, classifies patch failures, drafts retry jobs. Cannot reboot without human approval.

agents.name: Knowledge / ITSM Agent
agents.description: Auto-documents incidents with RCA drafts, publishes KB articles, prepares handovers.

agents.name: Backup & DR Agent
agents.description: Verifies restore integrity, measures RTO/RPO, maintains contingency-plan evidence.

quality.name: Groundedness against source telemetry
quality.detail: Every claim in an agent summary is checked back against the ITSM record, metric series or CMDB entry it cites.

quality.name: Citation coverage on RCA drafts
quality.detail: Share of assertions in generated RCAs that carry a traceable source reference.

quality.name: Unsupported-claim rate
quality.detail: Claims flagged by the evaluator as unsupported by retrieved context. Sampled at 20% of generations.

quality.name: Remediation action precision
quality.detail: Executed actions that matched the approved runbook step exactly, with no drift.

quality.name: False alert-correlation rate
quality.detail: Alerts grouped into an incident that a human later separated.

quality.name: Human override rate
quality.detail: Agent recommendations rejected or materially edited by the on-call engineer.

guardrails.name: No unapproved production writes
guardrails.detail: Patch Agent blocked from rebooting 19 staged servers — reboot requires explicit human approval.

guardrails.name: Change freeze respected
guardrails.detail: Patch wave held back from 22 Olive servers under the release freeze expiring 2 Aug.

guardrails.name: Blast radius ceiling
guardrails.detail: No runbook attempted to touch more than 2 of 6 app nodes concurrently.

guardrails.name: Retention policy enforcement
guardrails.detail: Storage reclaim cross-checked against the 7-year claims records mandate before any deletion.

guardrails.name: PHI redaction on model input
guardrails.detail: Member identifiers stripped from 41 log excerpts before they were sent to a model.

audit.note: Every agent action is written to an immutable log with approver identity, timestamp, justification and rollback handle.
